scope: Independent checked paper admission components consumed as one task-local snapshot; not a fresh profitable run or whole-strategy optimization certificate

implemented.independent_selections: Rank canary, sniper subprofile, late momentum and moonshot have separate allowlisted policies/<component>/active_policy.json paths. Each component rechecks its own original complete paired cohort and immediate predecessor evidence. A failed or expired component falls back to configured settings without disabling valid peers. The old root manifest is read-only compatible; an existing modern namespace prevents resurrection after retirement
implemented.stable_composition: One immutable task-local view combines only individually checked components, with at most two bounded admission parameters per component. Each component retains its own revision, configured hash and evidence identity in detached telemetry. Global CFG, position sizing, routes, security, exits, quotas and live settings are unchanged. Concurrent tasks, cancellation and manifest changes during network awaits cannot mix entry snapshots
implemented.cache_integrity: Checked selection caches are keyed by the scoped component manifest path and never lend their mutable parameters to callers. Source signatures and the existing five-second full replay bound remain checked independently per component
implemented.proposal_schedule: One global prospective cohort and the existing shared market/capacity/secondary quote budgets remain. Components rotate with independent local neighbor indices; a selected rank profile no longer monopolizes research. An absent preferred gate rotates after five minutes of event-observed waiting, independent of future returns. Corrupt, unknown and backwards schedule state is preserved and fails closed. Interrupted pointer cleanup cannot advance the cursor twice
implemented.actual_late_router: The actual green-sniper dispatcher now consumes the same selected late-momentum minimum as the late filter. It registers the bounded minimum-threshold routing envelope before dispatch, so prospective alternatives can include opportunities below the current admission threshold. Duplicate router/filter hooks register and reserve only once. A bounded lower-minimum proposal complements the existing higher-maximum proposal; flags authorizing paper/live purchases are not changed
implemented.extreme_runner_contract: No percentage upside ceiling was introduced. Earlier runner policies and synthetic extreme-tail protections remain, with exact 0.1 SOL orders and continuing liquidity, cost, route and holding-time constraints. Extreme price rises alone do not prove executable profit

This is software validation only: no new market run, actual memecoin transaction or wallet gain

remaining_full_goal_requirements: Complete scanner/core admission, capital allocation, provider freshness and execution constraints across the whole actual strategy; independent component improvements are not evidence of profitable composition
Complete fresh rare-runner/risk/continuation validation and system-level failure-path acceptance
Obtain separately authorized prospective complete-strategy closed evidence with executable quantities and defensible costs before any profitability or live-activation claim
